title: Busan Rain Walk | Exploring from Busan Station to Nampo-dong | Korea 4K Walking Tour
description:
Join me for a relaxing rainy afternoon walk in Busan! We start at Busan Station and head towards Nampo-dong, passing through Choryang-dong, Jungang-dong, and the famous Yongdusan Park. This journey is all about exploring the city's charming alleyways, giving you a glimpse into the authentic, real heart of Busan. Experience the unique atmosphere of the city under the rain.

00:00 Busan Station
01:34 Texas Street
03:50 Busan Chinatown
08:35 New Yeongju Market
16:27 Yeongju-dong
32:01 Jungang-dong
45:19 Busan Tower
54:45 Gwangbok-ro Fashion Street
1:02:55 BIFF Square
